description: Contributor policy blocklist. Empty by design. No contributor, vendor, model family, or agent session is named here. Entries are added only when the policy's evidence bar is met and a maintainer records a decision. See README.md and the contributor policy in ../2026-10-13-regression/03-lessons-and-contributors.md.

policy.probation: Two confirmed escaped material defects attributable to the same contributor or tool configuration within 90 days.
policy.block: Three confirmed material incidents within 90 days, including at least one repeated failure class after its documented correction, or a verified deliberate bypass of required validation.
policy.reinstatement: Repair outstanding incidents, demonstrate the failed contracts under the new gate, and pass three independently reviewed scoped contributions. A block is reviewed after 30 days and renewed only with stated evidence.
policy.appeal: An appeal can correct attribution, severity, or causation at any time. Link it from the entry's appealLink.

fields.id: Stable record id for this entry.
fields.contributorReference: Opaque reference to the demonstrated contributor or tool configuration. Never a vendor, model family, or agent session name.
fields.incidentRecords: Ids of the confirmed incident records behind this entry.
fields.evidence: Links to the confirming artifacts, such as incident records and verification runs.
fields.expiry: ISO date the entry is reviewed.
fields.remediation: What must be done to clear the entry.
